annotations.text:
agnt session list — the modern look

Top row is what ships: the two views, tinted. Colour comes from the terminal's own palette (named ANSI colours), so it wears yours rather than bringing its own.

Bottom row is the two directions considered and not taken, kept so the choice is visible.

The palette, and what each colour means:

· amber — a session that needs you (glyph and heading)
· green — one that is working
· magenta — PR and issue references
· blue — the brand mark, the cursor bar, the caret

Colour is additive: every state also has its glyph and its word.
